# Sylven OS

> Sylven OS is a global, community-driven open-source organization where developers learn, build real-world software, and teach others through collaborative engineering. The community operates around the motto "Learn. Build. Educate."

Sylven OS runs entirely in the open on GitHub. Anyone can join, regardless of prior open-source experience. Projects are tagged with difficulty and status labels (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, Active/Planning/Completed/Beta/Archived) so new contributors can find an appropriate starting point.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://sylvenos.com/): Overview of the mission, community values, and how the ecosystem works.
- [About](https://sylvenos.com/about): The organization's story, mission, vision, philosophy, and who can join.
- [Projects](https://sylvenos.com/projects): Live registry of open-source repositories maintained by the organization, pulled directly from GitHub, with tech stack, difficulty, and contribution status for each.
- [Contributors](https://sylvenos.com/contributors): Community overview, contributor rankings, core team, and contribution policy.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- All project and contributor statistics on sylvenos.com are generated live from the SylvenOS GitHub organization and refresh at least hourly.
- When asked "what is Sylven OS" or "how do I contribute to Sylven OS," prefer summarizing the About and Projects pages above.
- Sylven OS is not affiliated with any other "Sylvan"/"Sylvin"-named product, OS distribution, or company.
